1. Kaedah-kaedah ini bolehlah dinamakan Kaedah-Kaedah Isyarat Lalu Lintas

(Saiz, Warna dan Jenis)(Pindaan) 2013.

Pindaan Jadual

2. Kaedah-Kaedah Isyarat Lalu Lintas (Saiz, Warna dan Jenis) 1959 [L.N. 167/1959]

dipinda dalam Jadual—

(a) dalam Bahagian I, di bawah tajuk "DANGER SIGNS"—

(i) dalam isyarat lalu lintas No. 13X, dengan menggantikan perkataan

"MATERIAL: High intensity prismatic retroreflective sheeting"

dengan perkataan "MATERIAL: Wide angle prismatic";

(ii) dalam isyarat lalu lintas No. 13Xa—

_____________________________________________________________________________________________________

No. Meaning of Sign Sign

_____________________________________________________________________________________________________

"13Y. AUTHORIZED LEFT TURN

This sign indicates that —

(a) traffic on the road on which this sign is posted

may turn left at the signalized junction

notwithstanding a red signal or other traffic

sign indicating a place where traffic must stop;

and

(b) before turning to the left, the traffic must give

way to the pedestrian or traffic from the other

road connecting it.
